ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 high-intensity white to low-intensity black ratio; white pixels dominate the dorsal-central areas of both lobes, while black pixels occupy the outer perimeter and the median vertical divider.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous high-intensity white blobs located centrally in left and right lobes; bounded by a thick, low-intensity black border (approx. 20-50 pixels wide) along the trailing and leading edges; irregular mottling interface between black and white zones near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical fluke height at the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The upper boundary (leading edge) displays high-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude peaks (sawtooth pattern); the lower boundary (trailing edge) displays low-frequency, smooth-curve undulations with minimal serration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral symmetrical sweep; leading edge follows a low-degree convex curve; trailing edge follows a higher-degree concave curve toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, low-intensity circular pixel clusters detected within the high-intensity white region of the right lobe, specifically in the upper-quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, near-vertical low-intensity linear marks cutting through the white intensity field on the left lobe, approximately 1/4 length from the left distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular, jagged morphological deformation on the extreme distal tip of the left lobe, showing high-contrast pixel fragmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark speckled 'island' pattern on the right lobe interior where low-intensity pixels are isolated within the high-intensity field, distinct from the more uniform white mapping on the left lobe.
